person.description: Index into persons[]. Validated, but /formW2Gs has no per-item filer fact in ty2025, so nothing on the federal return turns on which filer holds the W-2G.

winnings_cents.description: W-2G box 1, reportable winnings. Required: the form is issued because a reportable win crossed a threshold, so a blank box 1 is an unread box, not a win of nothing. Reaches Schedule 1 line 8b and Form 1040 line 9. Never negative.

federal_withholding_cents.description: W-2G box 4, federal income tax withheld. Optional — blank is an ordinary state of the box; absent is computed as zero and stated in the response. Reaches Form 1040 line 25c, inside line 25d. Never negative.
